canonical_name: singular value decomposition theorem family with unresolved duplicate, scalar, shape, and factor conventions
category: 其他重要领域 / 数值分析
statement_blocker: An independently reviewed immutable source and duplicate-ownership decision must select one binder-complete proposition, including scalar field, dimensions and indices, full/thin/compact shape, factor orientation, diagonal and singular-value conventions, existence/uniqueness boundary, and empty cases.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must select Real, Complex, both, or another scalar abstraction; rectangular dimensions and finite index types; and every universe and typeclass parameter.
conclusion: Open: the catalog names an SVD but does not specify factor shapes, predicates, singular-value data, product orientation, existence/uniqueness, or exact boundary cases.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before an exact proposition is source-selected; empty dimensions, zero/rank-deficient matrices, repeated and zero singular values, all dimension comparisons, factor nonuniqueness, and ordering ties remain open.
candidate_scope_not_credited: full finite rectangular Real SVD with square orthogonal factors
full finite rectangular Complex SVD with square unitary factors
a conjunction or scalar-generic encoding of both Real and Complex cases
compact SVD indexed by rank or positive singular values
excluded_substitutions: square, normal, Hermitian, positive, invertible, full-rank, fixed-size, real-only, or complex-only cases silently replacing the unidentified general scope
singular-value existence, nonnegativity, ordering, support, or eigenvalue relationships without construction of both factors and final equality
the spectral theorem for A* A without left singular vectors, basis extension, rectangular zero tail, and final matrix equality
polar, QR, Schur, eigenvalue, or ordinary diagonalization theorems
thin, compact, or full SVD silently substituted for another factor shape
an approximate numerical SVD, residual check, algorithm, oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate
a structure or hypothesis already storing the desired factorization

the catalog's untrusted verified label or the intake API probe as proof credit

computation_profile: No floating-point SVD implementation, approximation, experiment, oracle, unchecked certificate, generated residual, or native shortcut is credited; the eventual theorem requires exact source-mapped kernel evidence
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib under machine-theorem-assurance/1.0; no canonical SVD target is encoded

owners_and_reviewers.reviewer_policy: Independent source and formal reviewers must approve the selected proposition, source crosswalk, duplicate identity, factor conventions, boundary cases, and formal target; the integration lane separately decides master acceptance.

review_due: before master acceptance or any dependent statement work
support_window: provisional intake only; expires on any invalidation input and cannot support release
archive_and_recovery_boundary: Repository Git history plus the integration lane's durable worker snapshot are the intended recovery mechanism after acceptance; this unaccepted worker dossier has no independent archive or release-recovery claim.
revocation_and_incident_procedure: The integration lane rejects or supersedes the provisional receipt, records the reason, and requires a fresh scoped intake and self-test against current immutable inputs.
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction, source edition or errata finding, THM-M-0044 identity or ownership decision, selected scalar/domain/index/factor/diagonal/order/uniqueness/boundary convention, Lean target, toolchain or dependency pin, assurance profile, validator, or any owned artifact change; independent review and master acceptance remain open.
